jobs.description:
For a family-run metal workshop specializing in the production of steel doors and windows, we are looking for a semi-automatic welder to join the team. The company is known for its high-quality finishes, attention to detail, and passion for interior design and architecture. Every project is tailor-made — from design to the finished product — with a strong focus on craftsmanship and precision.

Job description:
As a semi-automatic welder, you will help produce steel doors and windows for both interior and exterior applications. You will be responsible for very fine welding work and ensure that every piece meets the highest quality standards.

Your tasks:

• 
Performing fine welding work (semi-automatic)

• 
Filing, grinding, and assembling components

• 
Cleaning and smoothing weld seams

• 
Reading and interpreting technical drawings

• 
Delivering precise, high-quality work

Profile:

• 
You have experience as a welder or are a motivated school leaver

• 
You can read and understand technical plans

• 
You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English

• 
You enjoy detailed, varied work during day shifts

Responsibilities

• Audit business processes to identify digital optimization opportunities and high-value AI use cases.
• Develop a Proof of Concept (POC) for the automated reading and categorization of technical project documentation.
• Extract specific parameters from documents and images to automatically populate machine databases.
• Transform technical manuals into structured, reusable maintenance instructions for field operations.
• Evaluate innovative solutions for in-the-field information retrieval using geo-based or mobile technologies.
• Collaborate with stakeholders to design checklists and feedback loops for post-maintenance reporting.

Requirements

• 5+ years experience in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning.
• 3+ years in Business Process Management and Business Process Re-engineering.
• Possess experience with automated document processing and image analysis technologies.
• Bring experience in developing Proof of Concepts (POC) within a corporate environment.
• Proactive and solution-oriented approach.
• You are fluent in Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of English.
• Familiarity with mobile or geo-based information retrieval systems.
• Interest in voice assistant technology applications.

Responsibilities

• Create the concept and manage the planning for preliminary analysis and design phases.
• Perform functional analysis of information systems and deliver functional designs following pre-studies.
• Support changes and enhancements throughout the lifecycle from development to production.
• Recommend and implement strategic system enhancements to optimize performance.
• Develop new program requirements and specifications to address specific business needs.
• Analyze service requests to determine feasibility, technological changes, resource requirements, and time estimates.

Requirements

• You have 5+ years of experience in the functional design of information systems within the banking or insurance sectors.
• You bring 3+ years of experience as a functional analyst in complex technical environments.
• You possess 2+ years of experience in software development with Java and Java SDK.
• You have experience working with Agile Methodologies.
• You possess knowledge of IT Security and Open Systems.
• You're proficient in using Jira and Confluence.
• You possess strong analytical skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
• You are a team player with clear and structured communication skills.
• You are fluent in English with active knowledge of Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with data-driven decision-making processes.

Are you passionate about delivering an outstanding employee technology experience? Do you enjoy acting as the bridge between business needs and IT services? Are you looking for a role where you can shape and improve the modern workplace within a growing international organization?

As Workplace Lead, you will own and continuously enhance the digital workplace environment, ensuring employees have the tools, support, and technology they need to perform at their best.

You will act as the key point of contact for workplace services, driving service excellence, managing vendors, and supporting digital transformation initiatives across the business.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and execute the Digital Workplace roadmap in line with business objectives.
• Ensure the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of workplace technologies and collaboration tools.
• Manage end-user computing services, collaboration platforms, devices, and workplace-related infrastructure.
• Oversee external IT service providers and ensure agreed service levels are met.
• Monitor user satisfaction, identify areas for improvement, and implement best practices to enhance the employee experience.
• Lead workplace-related projects, including technology rollouts, migrations, and process improvements.
• Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to understand operational needs and translate them into effective technology solutions.
• Support IT governance, cybersecurity, and compliance initiatives related to workplace services.
• Manage budgets and contracts within the workplace domain.
• Contribute to shaping a modern, efficient, and user-centric technology environment.

 

Profile

• Several years of experience in Digital Workplace, End-User Services, IT Operations, or Workplace Management.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, device management, and modern workplace technologies.
• Experience managing third-party vendors and service providers.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Strong customer-service mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality user experiences.
• Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, international environment.
• Fluent in English; additional European languages are considered a plus.

Responsibilities

• Perform technical analysis and design for data exchange services and REST APIs to ensure system integration.
• Develop robust application components using PHP and JavaScript to support architectural evolution.
• Modernize strategic solutions by integrating new functionalities related to AI and data analysis.
• Collaborate with development teams to define technical architecture and ensure secure, interoperable outcomes.
• Participate in the full development lifecycle within a DevOps and Agile environment.

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in backend and frontend development using PHP and JavaScript.
• 3+ years of experience designing and implementing REST APIs and Web Services.
• 3+ years of experience working with SQL, NoSQL, and PostgreSQL databases.
• 3+ years of experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT-Based Tokens.
• 3+ years of experience in Software Architecture and applying Design Principles and patterns.
• 3+ years of experience with Containerization and DevOps workflows, specifically using GitLab.
• 3+ years of experience implementing Security By Design and application security protocols.
• You are proactive, autonomous, and possess strong problem-solving skills with a focus on quality.
• You are native in French or Dutch with passive knowledge of the other and have active knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• 1+ years of experience with automated testing.

We are looking for an experienced seamstress/seamster for a mattress manufacturing company in the Maldegem region!

What will your tasks be?

• You will be responsible for sewing covers and closing the mattresses.
As you gain more experience, we will teach you additional tasks step by step, such as:

• inserting zippers
• sewing on ribbons
• other finishing details

What do we expect from you? 

• You work accurately and contribute to a high-quality end product.
• You already have some experience with sewing or working on a sewing machine.
• You work precisely and are quality-oriented.
• You speak Dutch or English well!
• The job is mainly done standing up, so you must be physically able to do this.

For our client, a company in the Ghent region that operates in the steel industry, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Overhead Crane Operator.

Your tasks: 

• You will be responsible for lifting and moving steel plates using the overhead crane.
• You will work independently.
• You must not be afraid of heights and must have good depth perception.
• You have to load the trucks with metal parts.
• Correctly positioning the metal coils in the warehouse. 
Who are you?
• You speak English well
• You live within a 30-km radius of Evergem and have your own transport. 
• You enjoy working independently and do so effectively, are not afraid of heights, and have good depth perception.
• You are a hard worker.
• Experience as a crane operator.

You will 
support the 
implementation of the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) within our European logistics network. By 
working closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders, you will ensure that packaging processes comply with 
legal requirements and meet established project objectives. 

 
• Track and monitor suppliers’ compliance with the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) to ensure project deadlines are met on time. 
 
• Organize and facilitate online meetings with suppliers. 
 
• Discussing and clarifying different types of packaging and the roles and responsibilities of suppliers. 
 
• Explaining the PPWR requirements and expectations regarding compliance. 
 
• Coordinating implementation plans and setting target dates for execution. 
 
• Closely monitoring suppliers’ corrective actions and implementation plans, including tracking progress, milestones, and deadlines. 
 
• Preparing weekly reports for management on suppliers’ compliance status. 
 
• Identifying risks, areas of concern, and escalations that require further management support. 
 
• Conducting compliance audits and checks on manufacturer labels within warehouse operations. 
 
• Verifying that packaging and labeling processes comply with applicable PPWR guidelines and internal quality standards. 
 
• Actively contributing to a compliant, efficient, and sustainable supply chain within the logistics operation.  

Education and Relevant Experience:  

 
• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a technical, logistics, or business-related field. 
 
• Experience with sustainable packaging solutions is a plus.  
 
Competencies & Skills:  

 
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing. 
 
• You have strong communication skills and know how to interact professionally with various stakeholders. 
 
• You have a good knowledge of Excel and are proficient in using SharePoint. Knowledge of Access and Power BI for data analysis and tracking is a plus. 
 
• You are able to manage multiple vendors, tasks, and deadlines simultaneously. 
 
• You work in a structured manner and have strong organizational and prioritization skills. 
 
• You are meticulous, reliable, and able to work independently. 
 
• You take initiative and proactively follow up on tasks to achieve set objectives. 
 
• You are motivated to further develop yourself and are determined to achieve challenging goals. 
 
• You base your recommendations and decisions on facts and feedback. 
 
• You have strong planning and organizational skills. 
 
• You enjoy working as part of a team, show respect for others, and believe in people’s growth. 
 
• You combine a positive attitude and a sense of humor with a strong work ethic. 
 
• You constantly contribute ideas for improvements and actively seek ways to optimize processes.

We are looking for Meat Production Workers for a growing food company!

The company processes ham and packages it for various supermarket chains.

The job is not physically demanding!

Early shift: 5:00 a.m.–1:30 p.m.

Late shift: 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m.

You get a half-hour break.

What are your responsibilities?

• As a packer, you will slice and package ham
• Work in cold/cool temperatures
• You will work in the Oudenaarde area
• You will speak in English, Polish or Ukrainian with your colleagues

For our client, we are looking for a motivated car body technician who enjoys working with vehicles and is not afraid to get hands-on.

You will join an experienced team in a car body repair company specialized in accident damage repairs.
What will you do?
• Disassemble vehicle body parts 
• Reassemble car components after repairs 
• Work on vehicles damaged in accidents 
• Use basic tools (screws, bolts, removing and reattaching parts) 
What do we expect from you?
• Experience with cars or bodywork is an advantage 
• Strong work ethic and motivation to work 
• Careful and precise approach to tasks 
• A team player with a humble attitude Languages
• No knowledge of Dutch required 
• Basic English is sufficient for communication 
• The team already includes international workers (including Polish and Albanian colleagues)

For a family-owned company located in Oudenburg, we are looking for a WORKSHOP CARPENTER.

Do you enjoy making and installing windows? We got you!

As a WINDOW INSTALLER in the Oudenburg region, your tasks will include:

  • Manufacturing and installing wooden balustrades and windows;
  • Reading technical plans and measuring the correct dimensions on wooden structures;
  • Operating CNC machines and specific woodworking machines;
  • Producing window frames;
  • Responsible for the installation of carpentry work;
  • Making and installing custom-made windows and doors (aluminium, PVC, wood, etc.).
As a WINDOW INSTALLER in Oudenburg, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You have experience as a carpenter;
  • You speak Dutch or English
  • Physical work does not scare you!

For our client in the KOEKELARE region, we are looking for a BRICKLAYER.

Our client is a family-owned construction company with 30 years of experience. They specialize in new builds and structural work for apartments and houses, mainly for real estate agencies and larger projects.

Your tasks as a BRICKLAYER in KOEKELARE:

  • Carrying out bricklaying work;
  • Performing masonry and formwork tasks;
  • Building interior and exterior walls in fast construction, façade, and visible brickwork;
  • Setting out brickwork according to plans and checking levels;
  • Pointing and finishing walls.
This is you as a BRICKLAYER in KOEKELARE:

  • Some experience as a bricklayer;
  • Good command of Dutch or English;
  • Driving license B is a plus, but not required if you can get to the site independently;
  • Enjoy working in a team and have a strong work ethic.

For our client, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE.
The company specializes in both small and large renovation projects throughout West Flanders. They handle full A-to-Z renovations as well as smaller works such as bathroom renovations, mainly for private clients, with occasional assignments for companies and organizations.

As a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE, your tasks include:

  • Assisting with paving, small renovations, and indoor works
  • Preparing renovation works (measuring, basic demolition, preparing materials)
  • Installing plasterboard (gyproc), small masonry tasks, and simple carpentry
  • Assisting with floor and tile installation and basic interior finishing
  • Supporting full renovation projects from A to Z
  • Preparing materials, assisting with installation, finishing, and site cleanup
As a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You have initial experience as a renovation worker
  • You speak Dutch or English
  • You are not afraid of physical work

For our client in the Veurne region, we are looking for a DIAGNOSTIC TECHNICIAN.

The garage not only sells and rents high-quality German vehicles, but also carries out maintenance and repairs to the highest standards.

As a Diagnostic Technician in the Veurne region, your responsibilities include:

  • Performing vehicle diagnostics;
  • Establishing diagnoses and setting up diagnostic equipment;
  • Carrying out repairs and replacing parts;
  • Working on passenger cars, vans and trucks (depending on experience and skills);
  • Performing maintenance work;
  • Resolving mechanical and electronic issues.
As a Diagnostic Technician in the Veurne region, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You already have a basic knowledge of automotive technology;
  • You are a motivated technician with a passion for technology;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client in VEURNE, we are looking for an INDUSTRIAL ELECTRICIAN.

Our client is a well-known company in Veurne, responsible for electrical projects from A to Z.

As an INDUSTRIAL ELECTRICIAN in VEURNE, your responsibilities include:

  • Installing electrical installations in the residential and industrial sectors;
  • Connecting electrical cabinets;
  • Laying cables, chasing and cutting;
  • Carrying out work based on plans and bills of quantities;
  • Managing a team of 2–3 people;
  • Executing projects from A to Z.
As an INDUSTRIAL ELECTRICIAN in OSTEND, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You have relevant experience as an industrial and/or residential electrician;
  • You hold a Category B driving licence;
  • Physical work is not a problem for you;
  • You speak Dutch, English, or French.
